title: A foot in two places
hook: Related animals can move through different surroundings.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The first drawing shows a broad flattened flipper; the second shows a foot contacting a surface. These represent selected aquatic and terrestrial examples, not every turtle species or a measurement of movement.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In these schematic examples, which limb is shaped for moving through water?
